tasks.final_text: The men's singles was a tennis event held as part of the tennis program at the 1904 Summer Olympics. It was the third time the event was held at the Olympics. There were 27 competitors from 2 nations. The event was won by Beals Wright, with the Americans sweeping the medals.

Last night, I had a lot of trouble getting to sleep. I can fall asleep quite easily if it is fairly quiet, and if I am not overthinking. Too much noise will usually wake my brain up and keep me awake for longer than usual. Unfortunately for me I live in the dorms, and that means people will scream and shout and cackle sometimes at 12am. That occurred last night.
